dictionary.scope: North American English pronunciation; not CEFR or curriculum lexicon

formula_basis.location: Understanding readability scores: formulas/ASL/ASW and U.S.grade interpretation

input_contract: Exact prepared text, explicit codepoint sentence ranges, kind/review statuses and preparation evidence; no silent period split
prohibitions: No guessed syllables for unknown/foreign words
No score for nonprose/gapped or unreviewed text/boundaries
No clipped formula feature converted to Chinese grade/CEFR/Lexile
No pronunciation envelope claimed as statistical confidence interval
limitations: Only original structural fixtures tested, not independently reviewed curriculum passages
Exact tokenizer differs from Word; no crossanalyzer equality claimed
Questions/options, knowledge, visuals, scaffolding and learner effects separate
Dictionary/license changed identity refuses execution; boundary review claims require real evidence outside code
